purpose: Machine-readable intent router for AI artifact generation. Routes natural-language page requests to a catalog pattern and a build-artifact example.

dashboard.intent: Read-mostly overview home: a KPI metric strip over optional charts and an activity/alert feed, answering 'is the system healthy and what needs attention' at a glance.
chooseWhen: The request says dashboard, overview home, home, landing, console home, system overview, fleet overview, or KPI summary.
The page summarizes the health/activity of a whole system or fleet, not one collection or one record.
avoidWhen: The request is a browsable/filterable collection (use list-page).
The request is one record's detail/profile (use detail-page).
clarifyIf: The request says home or overview but really describes a single collection to browse (that is list-page).

settings.intent: Read-write preferences surface: related controls grouped into setting cards, reached through a left section nav, each group saving its own changes; optionally a trailing Danger zone for destructive actions.
chooseWhen: The request says settings, preferences, configuration, options, workspace/account settings, or admin config.
The page is grouped toggles/selects/values the user scans and flips (setting rows), not a single record-entry form.
avoidWhen: The request is a single-step record create/edit form (use create-form).
The request is one record's read-mostly profile/detail (use detail-page).
clarifyIf: The request says settings but really describes a single create/edit form (that is create-form).

actions.intent: A reference or sandbox page for page actions: confirm delete, export, bulk action, status transition, relation picker, copy id.
chooseWhen: The user asks to demonstrate action behavior rather than a full business screen.
The request is about delete confirmation, export, bulk operations, status change, copy, or relation assignment.
avoidWhen: The user asks for a full list, detail, create, edit, or wizard page.

create-form.intent: Single-step form for creating, registering, editing, or capturing one record.
chooseWhen: The request says register, sign up, create account, create record, new record, edit, profile form, or a simple form.
The flow has one step or two simple sections and no branching or review-before-commit requirement.
The user asks for a registration interface without saying multi-step onboarding.
avoidWhen: There are three or more steps.
The flow has branching, staged dependencies, or a required review step.
The user asks to browse or manage a collection.
The user asks for settings, preferences, or configuration.
exampleRequests: 请帮我做一个注册界面
clarifyIf: The request mentions registration but also says onboarding, review, approval, or multiple stages.

create-wizard.intent: Multi-step create flow with stages, dependencies, branching, summary rail, or review-before-commit.
chooseWhen: The request says wizard, multi-step, onboarding, setup flow, guided create, review, staged entry, or branching.
The flow has three or more steps.
The user needs a review step before commit or a confirmation done state.
avoidWhen: The request is a short single-step registration or edit form.
The request is an edit flow; edits stay create-form, not wizard.
exampleRequests: 做一个带复核步骤的新增流程
clarifyIf: The request says onboarding but only lists a few fields and no stages.

detail-page.intent: Read-mostly page for one record with identity, metadata, overview fields, activity, tabs, and record-level actions.
chooseWhen: The request asks for profile, detail, one-record overview, record page, account page, customer detail, order detail, or read-only facts about one entity.
The page is reached from a list row and actions mutate that one record.
avoidWhen: The request is primarily about browsing many records.
The request is primarily about entering a new record.
clarifyIf: The request says customer page but does not say whether it is a list or one customer's profile.

master-detail.intent: One screen where a left list rail of records sits beside a right pane that shows/edits the selected record — the list and the record being worked stay visible together; selecting a rail row swaps the pane in place, never navigating away.
chooseWhen: The request asks to browse a bounded set AND view/edit one record beside the list on the SAME screen (a left list + a right detail/editor), not navigating away to a separate detail route.
Roles & permissions, firmware versions per hardware, a category editor, admin users — pick one on the left, edit it on the right.
avoidWhen: A row should navigate to its own detail route/page (use list-page then detail-page).
There is no persistent list beside the record (use detail-page), or the left rail is anchor-nav within one long page (use settings).
exampleRequests: 做一个角色权限管理页，左边角色列表，右边编辑权限
Build a roles and permissions screen with a list and an editor side by side
左侧固件版本列表，右侧版本详情的主从页面
clarifyIf: The request says manage X but does not say whether the record opens in place beside the list (master-detail) or on its own page (list-page then detail-page).

gallery.intent: Browse a collection as a responsive GRID OF TILES/CARDS led by each item's image — the tile counterpart to list-page. Products, images, models, templates, media; scroll/load-more/paginate below the grid.
chooseWhen: The request asks to browse a catalog/storefront/gallery of items as CARDS or TILES with images (product catalog, image gallery, template/model picker), comparing items visually.
The item's picture is the primary thing to scan, and the whole tile opens its detail.
avoidWhen: The collection is scanned/sorted by COLUMNS (dates, amounts, statuses) or needs bulk row-select — that is list-page (a data-table).
It is a fixed KPI/overview of a whole system (dashboard), not a browsable collection.
exampleRequests: 做一个商品目录/画廊浏览页（卡片网格）
Build a product catalog / storefront browse page with image tiles
做一个图片素材库的网格浏览页，滚动加载更多
clarifyIf: The request says browse products/items but does not say whether as a card GRID (gallery) or a data TABLE (list-page).

list-page.intent: Collection page for browsing, filtering, selecting, and acting on many records.
chooseWhen: The request says list, management page, table, browse, filter, search, directory, index, customers, orders, invoices, users, or records.
The page's primary object is a collection, not one record.
avoidWhen: The request asks for one record detail or a single form.
The request needs a large advanced filter sheet; use list-page-advanced-filter route.
clarifyIf: The request says management page but could mean a dashboard rather than a table.

list-page-advanced-filter.intent: List page variant for collections whose filters outgrow the inline toolbar and need an advanced filter sheet.
chooseWhen: The request asks for a list/table page with many filter dimensions.
The user mentions advanced filters, filter drawer, filter sheet, saved criteria, date ranges, or many optional filters.
avoidWhen: The list only needs search plus one or two quick filters.
exampleRequests: 做一个带高级筛选的客户列表
Create an invoice list with a filter drawer
clarifyIf: The request says advanced but does not identify any extra filters.

decisionOrder: If the user explicitly asks for advanced filtering on a collection, choose list-page-advanced-filter.
If the user asks for a dashboard, overview home, landing, or KPI summary of a whole system or fleet (not a single collection or single record), choose dashboard.

If the user asks to browse a bounded collection AND view/edit one record beside the list on the SAME screen (a left list rail + a right detail/editor, not a separate detail route), choose master-detail.

If the user asks to browse a collection as a GRID OF IMAGE TILES/CARDS where the picture is the primary thing to compare (a product catalog, storefront, image/asset gallery, template/model picker), choose gallery.
If the user asks for many records, a management table, browsing, filtering, or search over a collection, choose list-page.
If the user asks for one record's profile, detail, overview, or activity, choose detail-page.
If the user asks for multi-step onboarding, setup, branching, or review-before-commit, choose create-wizard.
If the user asks for a settings/preferences/configuration screen — grouped toggles and selects the user scans and flips, not a single record form — choose settings.
If the user asks for registration, signup, create, edit, or a simple record-entry form, choose create-form.
If the user asks to demonstrate page actions themselves, choose actions.
aiFlow: Read this router and choose one route by decisionOrder.
Before building, evaluate the chosen route's clarifyIf entries. If one matches, resolve it from the request or ask instead of guessing.
Read route.contract and route.composites; configure each composite from its .md contract and .html sample.
Edit the generated artifact for business content.
